# Rockstar Auto Repair

> Rockstar Auto Repair is a full-service auto repair shop in downtown Benton Harbor,
> Michigan, offering steering, suspension, brake, engine, cooling, exhaust, and
> routine maintenance services with straightforward, published pricing.

Rockstar Auto Repair works on steering and suspension systems, brakes and tires,
cooling systems, engine service, exhaust systems, and routine maintenance (oil
changes, tune-ups). Pricing for common services is published and current, not a
placeholder or a range subject to a sales call.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rockstarautorepair.com/): overview and shop photos.
- [Request Service](https://rockstarautorepair.com/request-service/): schedule a repair by describing the vehicle and the work needed.
- [Services](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/): full service overview.
- [Steering](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/steering/): power steering diagnostics and repair.
- [Suspension](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/suspension/): shocks, struts, springs, control arms.
- [Brakes & Tires](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/brakes-tires/): brake service, tire sales, mounting, balancing, repair.
- [Cooling Systems](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/cooling-systems/): radiator inspection, pressure testing, coolant flush.
- [Tune Ups](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/tune-ups/): spark plugs, fuel system cleaning, performance checks.
- [Lube, Oil & Filter](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/oil-lube-filter/): oil changes, chassis lubrication, fluid top-offs.
- [Engine Service](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/engine-service/): inspection, filters, timing belt service.
- [Exhaust Systems](https://rockstarautorepair.com/services/exhaust-systems/): muffler and exhaust component replacement.
- [Free Estimate](https://rockstarautorepair.com/free-estimate/): request a price estimate for a described repair.
- [Specials](https://rockstarautorepair.com/specials/): published prices for common services.
- [Reviews](https://rockstarautorepair.com/reviews/): customer reviews.
- [Legal](https://rockstarautorepair.com/legal/): business and website legal information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rockstarautorepair.com/privacy-policy/): how form submissions are collected and used.
- [Terms of Service](https://rockstarautorepair.com/terms-of-service/): terms for using this website.
